Maya is Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft, MDE, GDE on Web performance, Nuxtjs Ambassador, founder of VueJS Israel, core maintainer of StorefrontUI, and a writer on JavaScript good practices. She likes working with ReactJS but always has a Vue in her heart.

She loves to learn and experiment with new frameworks while believing that strong Vanilla JavaScript knowledge is necessary for being a good web developer. When not coding, she enjoys traveling, reading manga, and sketching.
